admission.justification: A registration whose refresh option swallows the server spec leaves uvx without a command and makes it reject --config, so the documented install path never starts the server; the pin splits the example as uvx does and fails on that form.

applicability: The args of examples/mcp/server.example.json, the one common MCP registration example.
conditions: uvx takes --refresh-package with the package name agents-remember-mcp, then the package command agents-remember-mcp@latest, which receives --config and the settings path.
exclusions: Harness-specific configuration envelopes, which each install guide names.
The behaviour of uvx itself beyond its argument order.
